title: Line sketch: Cosmic Face in Orbit
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: The composition centers on a large circular face with eyes and an mouth, surrounded by sweeping curves, overlapping circles, and dangling linear forms. Bold flat shapes in contrasting colors create a dynamic, balanced composition across a light background. Technique features crisp outlines and unmodulated color fields typical of graphic abstraction (derived from painting #129).
